title: After the deadline fires, the runner calls kill_tree and then child.wait() with no bound
description: After the deadline fires, the runner calls kill_tree and then child.wait() with no bound. kill_tree also runs an external `kill` process via Command::status() with no bound. The module doc (line 9) states 'Every wait is bounded', which is false for these two waits. A child that SIGKILL cannot end promptly (for example, a process in uninterruptible I/O sleep on a hung filesystem or network mount) would leave the test blocked forever instead of failing with the captured stderr. Likelihood is low, but the path exists and contradicts the stated contract.
